reviews.name: Dusan Andjelovic
reviews.text:
"2 days Lahore Heritage & sightseeing guided tour" with guide Bilawal from Pastenlighten Tours.
We visited Lahore Fort, Badshahi Mosque, Wazir Khan Mosque, Shahi Hammam, some beautiful streets and the next day the Wahgah Border ceremony. Honestly Bilawal is one of the most knowledgeable and charismatic guides I have met so far. You will get all your questions answered and more. Rest assured that you won't miss a single detail about Lahore, Punjab and Pakistan as a whole, whether it is history, culture, food, souvenirs etc. Thank you Bilawal for an unforgettable experience!

reviews.name: ravinder dhesi
reviews.text: We had a tour of Lahore Fort and Badshahi mosque with Bilawal .  He speaks English very well and he pitched it just right for my granddaughter to understand as she is 6 years old and I wanted her to enjoy tour as I have already been before a few times.  My daughter and granddaughter really enjoyed their first visit and they still remember him.  Also very useful to have someone take photos of us all.  Definitely recommend to anyone.

reviews.name: Loredana Toader
reviews.text: I had an insightful and enjoyable Lahore walking tour with Pastenlighten Tours. Bilawal guided me through the Walled City of Lahore, Badshahi Mosque and Lahore Fort, sharing fascinating history and hidden stories. Bilawal is a natural storyteller and has a lot of knowledge and insight. He is also an amazing human being and keen to share his knowledge in a straightforward and passionate way.  I was interested in a Sufi tour of some of the shrines and Bilawal took me to a few Sufi shrines and it was an unforgettable experience for me to visit the shrines. I will always cherish these moments. I am really grateful for the opportunity to meet Bilawal and to do the tour and get to experience Pakistan's wonderful history. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Lahore.

reviews.name: A V
reviews.text: Bilawal was a God-send on my first day in Lahore as a solo female traveller. He showed me all the must-sees and hidden gems of the city and told me a lot of history I couldn’t get elsewhere. He was very considerate as well and gave me safety and transport advice and helped me get a taxi. I fell in love with the place and would love to return. Bilawal was a big part of the experience and I wish him very success and all the best. I recommend him highly and intend to contact him again if or when I return to Pakistan.

reviews.name: Cas T
reviews.text:
I had an amazing Lahore Heritage & sightseeing tour with Pastenlighten Tours. Bilawal guided me through the Jehangir Tomb, Asif Jah Tomb, Nur Jahan Tomb and Shalimar Gardens sharing fascinating history and hidden stories. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Lahore.

reviews.name: Lorena
reviews.text:
I honestly don’t even know where to begin because this experience in Pakistan exceeded anything I could have imagined. From the very first moment, your team made us feel welcomed, safe, cared for, and truly valued  not just as tourists, but as friends.

Traveling so far from home can sometimes feel intimidating, especially as a woman, but every single moment with your team was filled with kindness, professionalism, patience, and genuine warmth. You didn’t just show us places… you helped us experience the soul of Pakistan. From the breathtaking architecture, rich history, incredible food, and vibrant culture, to the heartfelt conversations and laughs throughout the day, everything felt unforgettable.

What touched me the most was the humanity and generosity your team showed us. I have traveled and met many people in my life, but it is very rare to meet individuals with such pure hearts, humility, and sincerity. Your passion for your country and for what you do shines through in every detail, and it made me fall in love with Pakistan even more.

Thank you for giving us memories that I know I will carry with me forever. I will always remember the beauty of Lahore, the laughter we shared, and the incredible care your team gave us. Anyone considering booking with you should do it without hesitation this was not just a tour, it was an experience filled with heart.

May God bless you, your team, and your business with endless success. I truly hope one day I can return to Pakistan and meet all of you again. 🇵🇰✨

reviews.name: Axel
reviews.text:
An unforgettable journey through Lahore

If you're looking to explore Lahore with depth, passion, and a personal touch, I wholeheartedly recommend this tour with Pastenlighten. Our guide, Bilawal, was nothing short of exceptional. His knowledge of Lahore’s history, architecture, and culture was outstanding, but what truly set the experience apart was his warmth, storytelling, and clear love for his city.

The itinerary was perfectly balanced—from the historical grandeur of Lahore Fort and Badshahi Mosque, to the intricate charm of Shahi Hammam and Gali Surjan Singh, all the way to the moving Wagah Border ceremony. Each stop was brought to life through Bilawal’s insights, and no question went unanswered.

We also appreciated thoughtful pacing and little local touches, like walking through Anarkali Bazaar at the end of the day or getting context on landmarks we passed, such as Iqbal’s Tomb and Delhi Gate. Even places not entered, like Masjid Wazir Khan, were made meaningful through Bilawal’s narration.

This wasn’t just a tour - it felt like being shown around by a friend who is deeply proud of his heritage.

Thank you, Bilawal, and Pastenlighten, for a truly memorable day in Lahore. Don’t hesitate to book this tour - you’ll come away enriched and inspired.

reviews.text: I visited Lahore together with my mother in October where we spent 3 days. We were part of a larger Pakistan tour. We really want to commend Bilawal for his amazing guide services. We were so jet lagged on the first day and he was extremely patient and carefully explained us everything. In addition, I was very impressed with how passionate he is about telling us all the stories, he really loves his job and is contagious! He also took us to some amazing restaurants which were our top of the whole trip. What a wonderful first experience in Pakistan

reviews.name: mak lashari
reviews.text: Came from London with my foreign friends , bilawal approached us with kindness and we went ahead with him to guide us throughout the fort, brilliant communication skills , english and urdu spoken, definitely recommended to anyone coming from abroad.

reviews.name: Tommaso Turri
reviews.text:
I had the absolute pleasure of exploring Lahore with Bilawal as my guide, and I can say without hesitation that he was exceptional in every possible way. From the moment our tour began, Bilawal showed incredible professionalism, warmth, and deep knowledge of the city’s rich history, culture, and hidden gems.

What truly set him apart was his genuine passion for Lahore — it’s contagious. He didn’t just show me the landmarks; he brought them to life with fascinating stories, local insights, and personal touches that made the experience unforgettable. Whether it was wandering through the old city, tasting the best street food, or admiring Mughal architecture, every moment felt personalized and meaningful.

Bilawal was also incredibly kind, respectful, and easy to talk to — the kind of guide who feels more like a friend by the end of the day. He went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable, safe, and having the best time possible.

If you’re visiting Lahore, I cannot recommend Bilawal highly enough. He made my trip truly special, and I’m grateful for the memories he helped create. Thank you, Bilawal!

reviews.text: Was referred to Bilawal by a friend who recently completed a Lahore city tour with him and praised the experience. He was an excellent and highly knowledgeable guide with a degree in Pakistan history to top it off. Very much recommended. Thanks Bilawal!

Would highly recommend him to anybody visiting Lahore or Pakistan more generally as he does a variety of trips and can accommodate your plans well.

reviews.name: Measha McIntyre
reviews.text: Bilawal was an excellent tour guide for me and showed me around Lahore. He is extremely knowledgeable about the history and culture of his country. His English is great and he is a lovely guy to chat with, hes also happy to customise any tours. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Boushra
reviews.text:
It was my first time to Pakistan and I had the pleasure of meeting Bilawal at the entrance of Badshahi Mosque , his warm and welcoming nature immediately set the tone for an unforgettable experience. He guided us through the main sights of Lahore, including the magnificent Lahore Fort, the serene Shalimar Gardens, and the historic Walled City. Bilawal’s deep knowledge of these landmarks, combined with his lively storytelling, made the rich history and culture of Lahore come alive. His fluent English and engaging manner ensured that we were never bored. Additionally, Bilawal suggested future tours in Skardu and Peshawar, offering valuable insights for our upcoming travels.

If you’re planning a visit to Lahore, I highly recommend choosing Bilawal as your guide—without ANY hesitation. His professionalism, passion, and dedication to making your experience special are unmatched. Thank you, Bilawal, for your exceptional guidance.

reviews.name: calum fox
reviews.text:
I recently visited Pakistan for the first time with friends from the UK, and it was an unforgettable experience. With so much to explore in the country, having Bilawal from Pastenlighten with us was truly a blessing. He made the entire trip seamless, especially when it came to accommodation and meals.
The way in which we were treated by Bilawal made us feel like we were family, a truly meaningful sense of care and love for us.

We enjoyed some absolutely amazing food—often off the typical tourist trail—and saw incredible sights during our road trip. When I return to Pakistan, I’ll definitely be reaching out to Pastenlighten again to discover even more of what this beautiful country has to offer!

reviews.name: Olga K.
reviews.text: Here I would like to express my most sincere gratitude to Bilawal who was my guide at the Lahore Fort last year during my second trip to Pakistan (the first one took place in 2023 and then I went “guideless”). He came up to me gently offering his services, and I accepted because after my first trip I decided to come again and hire a guide at the Fort. Bilawal was absolutely friendly and good-mannered as a person, knowledgeable and intelligent as a guide, patiently waiting for me while I was taking tonnes of pictures of the architectural marvels of my beloved Lahore. He speaks good English and his way of telling is quite lively and enjoyable, so you cannot be bored by all means! On top of that, Bilawal helped me with an essential thing for my further trip. I needed to go to Islamabad, and for some reasons I could not purchase online tickets (neither could my local Lahori-born friend since the app didn’t work for him either), so it was Bilawal who saved my further trip by helping me buy the ticket to Islamabad. I’m at a loss for words to say how incredibly grateful to him I am, this is a lifelong unforgettable experience which I immensely appreciate. Bilawal, thank you so much, stay safe and blessed! I hope to come again a.s.a.p., so it’d be great to see you again!

reviews.text: Bilawal was an amazing guide through Lahore who went above and beyond. I learnt so much about the history of Lahore fort, was introduced to some local favourite food spots, explored the markets, and had a great time. Highly recommend!
